historical_record.description: The Recreation and Park Commission approved schematic designs for a children's play area at Chinese Playground by Eckbo, Dean, Austin and Williams, who gave their design services; the work was paid for by an anonymous $20,000 gift with matching federal grant money, after three years' effort by the Committee for Better Parks and Recreation in Chinatown.
